name: workspace-home
title: Workspace home
description: A workspace start page in Tiles: a pill navbar, a large search, an inverted offer tile, deal bars and the week's schedule.

props.name: data
props.description: The navigation items, offer tile, deals chart and schedule to show.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text, with English defaults. Keys: search, searchLabel, navLabel, note.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called with the typed text when the search form is submitted.

props.name: onOffer
props.description: Called with no arguments when the offer tile's button is pressed.

a11y.text: A nav (default label "Workspace") with buttons; the current one has aria-current="page". A search form has role="search" and an input with an aria-label (default "Search"). Tiles are sections named by their h3; the charts are bar-chart and week-schedule, see their notes.

Nav buttons and the offer button are native with a focus-visible outline; the search field has no outline of its own, and the search form draws one around it while it has focus. Enter in the search field submits it to onSearch.
The button scales on press, and under reduced motion (motion-reduce) it does so without a transition.
